steps.caption: Option 4C · Side-by-side review. The brief on the left, the report on the right.
Pick a Feed item: the task opens left, its report right, with a review strip under the crumbs.
The strip holds the agent’s steps, the pending question, Send n notes and Accept.
Answer in the strip: the question leaves the strip and the Feed; the card says Working.
Review next walks the rest of the Feed in the same two panes.
No new mode: just the panes and tabs the app already has.
